entities.name: MUSIM UE
entities.description: A UE that supports one or more MUSIM features including N1 NAS signalling connection release, paging indication for voice services, reject paging request, paging restriction, and paging timing collision control.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which MUSIM feature support is indicated by UE and network.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: MUSIM feature for releasing N1 NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Paging indication for voice services
entities.description: MUSIM feature for paging indication specifically for voice services.

entities.name: Reject paging request
entities.description: MUSIM feature allowing UE to reject paging requests.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: MUSIM feature for restricting paging, indicated only with N1 NAS release or reject paging request support.

entities.name: Paging timing collision control
entities.description: MUSIM feature for controlling paging timing collisions, not indicated during registration.

entities.name: Emergency services registration
entities.description: Registration for emergency services where network does not indicate MUSIM feature support.

entities.name: NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Operating mode where UE does not indicate paging indication for voice services support.

entities.name: WB-N1 mode CE mode B
entities.description: Operating mode where UE does not indicate paging indication for voice services support.

relations.description: MUSIM UE indicates support of MUSIM features during registration procedure.
Registration procedure includes indication of N1 NAS signalling connection release support.
Registration procedure includes indication of reject paging request support.
Paging restriction support is indicated only if N1 NAS release or reject paging request is supported.
Paging restriction support is indicated only if N1 NAS release or reject paging request is supported.
During emergency services registration, network does not indicate MUSIM feature support.
UE in NB-N1 mode does not indicate paging indication for voice services support.
UE in WB-N1 mode CE mode B does not indicate paging indication for voice services support.
